matches.rationale: No finding identifies that the recommended datasets include invented 'antmaze-large-diverse' or 'maze2d-large' variants; the only dataset-related finding concerns an inconsistency between the recommended list and the evaluation set, which is a different issue.
No finding addresses asymmetric hyperparameter tuning budgets or the lack of control for differences in online tuning effort across methods.
No finding mentions the omission of critic diversity loss or model-based regularization terms from the unified actor loss, nor the inconsistent description of the BC loss as MSE vs. log-probability.

Findings 5 and 6 both demonstrate that the claimed speed-up numbers (e.g., 131.5× and 74.8×) are inconsistent with the data in Table 2 and Figure 5, capturing the same underlying issue of exaggerated and unsubstantiated speed improvements.
No finding mentions omitted error bars/confidence intervals or the deliberate suppression of similar/worse datasets for TD3‑AWR and MoBRAC.
No finding captures the overclaim in the Conclusion that the method achieves superior performance across a wide range without proper qualification.
No finding addresses the absence of ethical or safety considerations in the Introduction.

Finding 8 identifies that the citation numbers for Rainbow, Muesli, and Dual RL are erroneous, directly matching the ground-truth description of fabricated/misattributed references in the Related Work section.
No finding points out the inflated rhetorical language in the Abstract.
No finding mentions the contradiction between CQL being excluded from Unifloral in Section 4.2 but included in Appendix A.1.

Finding 3 shows that the purported EDAC implementation incorrectly uses a standard-deviation penalty instead of the proper gradient-diversity loss, capturing the pseudocode inconsistency described in this ground truth.
No finding identifies the tight y-axis scaling in Figures 3, 6, 7 that visually exaggerates differences.
No finding mentions the missing conflict-of-interest disclosures or the lack of funding transparency in the Acknowledgements.
No finding notes the incoherence between the broader taxonomy of offline RL variants and the evaluation's focus on only pre-deployment tuning.
No finding addresses the over-interpretation of distractor policy dips as meaningful evaluation flaws rather than statistical noise.
